turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A cooking competition show is the perfect background noise—entertaining, but you don't have to watch every second of it. Have you had any time for your woodworking lately, or has teaching taken over your free time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Teaching has definitely taken over this week, so my woodworking projects are on the back burner until the weekend.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Completely understandable. Balance is key, especially during grading season! I hope the lab reports go quickly tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm looking forward to a relaxing evening. Talk to you tomorrow!
